turnaround_reason: CNXC fell from ~$58 to ~$26 (down ~55%) as the market prices in AI disrupting its core customer-experience/BPO outsourcing business. Q2 2026 narrowly missed and management cut full-year guidance on accelerated client offshoring and cost pressure, sending shares down ~22% after hours. It screens optically cheap, but the burden of proof is on the AI-transition thesis.
bullish_points: Optically cheap with a low multiple; sell-side consensus is still 'Buy' (7 Buy / 2 Hold) with a median price target of ~$30 vs. ~$26 spot
AI-native iX Suite contract signings up ~400% YoY, evidence of a genuine (if early) pivot toward higher-value services
CEO Caldwell and CFO Valentine made small open-market purchases in 2026, showing some management conviction
Modest reported revenue growth (~1.9% YoY constant-currency) means the top line has not collapsed — yet
bearish_points: This is a possible value trap: AI is a direct, secular threat to the core seat-based outsourcing model, and a guidance CUT confirms the pressure is here now
Large insider-selling overhang: Groupe Bruxelles Lambert dumped 6.0M shares (~$133M) in April, dwarfing the token CEO/CFO buys (net -5.9M shares over 6m)
High leverage (debt/equity ~204) and a negative net margin (-13%) leave little cushion if revenue rolls over
The iX Suite growth is off a small base and must scale fast enough to offset legacy erosion — an unproven race
catalyst: Evidence that AI-powered iX Suite revenue is scaling fast enough to stabilize total revenue and margins, converting the AI story from threat to tailwind
catalyst_timing: Q3 2026 earnings; watch iX Suite as a percentage of revenue and any guidance stabilization
suggested_trade: Pass / watchlist only. Wait for a quarter that shows revenue and margins stabilizing before committing — the secular AI risk plus the GBL selling overhang argue against catching this now.
key_risk: AI accelerates client insourcing/offshoring faster than iX Suite can grow, so revenue and margins keep eroding and the 'cheap' multiple compresses further
would_skip_if: Next quarter shows further guidance cuts or continued margin erosion with no visible iX Suite offset (base case for now)
